integrity: The analytic proof establishes the theorem; finite code is only a regression check. Older qubit and pure-state Fisher-symmetry results and the broad 2026 support-size theorem are explicitly credited and excluded from the originality claim.
scientific_limitations: Local interior-point theorem for the full affine spin-factor ball with \(d\ge4\). It does not cover boundary points, curved submodels, a parameter-independent global measurement, or hardware-setting complexity. The \(d=3\) mixed-qubit case is prior work.
title: Outcome-minimal Fisher-symmetric POVMs for full spin-factor balls
